summary:
I checked the module contract (`life-cycle-uc8-uc9` skill) and the live backend reference repo for this exact capability.

**Finding:** This is not a frontend bug — it's an actual contract/backend limitation. The module's API surface for folder/tags is:
- `GET /api/v1/folder-tags` (list existing options)
- `POST /api/v1/contracts/{contractId}/folder-tags` (assign existing ids to a contract)

There is no create-folder/tag endpoint anywhere in this module's contract, and I confirmed in `/tmp/sage-refs/life-cycle-backend/app/routers/contract_lifecycle.py` that the backend itself only implements these same two routes (`list_folder_tags`, `assign_folder_tags`) — no POST to create a new folder or tag exists server-side. `src/features/contract-repository/components/AddFolderTagDialog.jsx` already correctly limits itself to assigning from the fetched options list, matching what the backend actually supports.

Per CLAUDE.md's hard rule ("Never invent a URL or a field name — the backend implements the same contract"), I can't add a "create folder/tag" call to the frontend without a corresponding backend endpoint — doing so would produce a 404/500 at runtime, not a working feature. Adding create capability requires a new backend endpoint (e.g. `POST /api/v1/folder-tags`) plus a contract update, which is out of scope for this repository.

I made no code changes, since fabricating the call would violate the no-invented-endpoints rule and wouldn't actually work.
